# Publish checklist (Google SEO)

Replace `YOUR-DOMAIN.com` in all files before publishing.

## Files in this folder

| File | Purpose | Suggested URL |
|------|---------|---------------|
| `landing-page.html` | Main product landing page | `/odoo-dynamic-dashboard` |
| `blog-01-best-odoo-dynamic-dashboard-2026.html` | Comparison / guide article | `/blog/best-odoo-dynamic-dashboard-2026` |
| `blog-02-create-dynamic-dashboard-odoo-19.html` | How-to article (HowTo schema) | `/blog/create-dynamic-dashboard-odoo-19` |

## Steps

1. Host these pages on your company website (WordPress, Odoo Website, Netlify, etc.).
2. Replace every `https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/...` with your real domain.
3. Link landing page ↔ Apps Store page and both blog posts to each other.
4. Set `website` in `__manifest__.py` to the landing page URL (instead of mailto) after it is live.
5. Submit the sitemap in [Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console).
6. Request indexing for the three URLs.
7. Share the blogs on LinkedIn / Odoo forums with a natural backlink.

## Target keywords

- Primary: `odoo dynamic dashboard`, `odoo dashboard builder`, `odoo 19 dashboard`
- Secondary: `ai dashboard odoo`, `create dynamic dashboard in odoo`, `odoo kpi dashboard`
